status: SIGNED - NCI-60 inputs may be staged; nothing in this record changes after signature
purpose: Regenerate the NCI-60 cell-line application under the current rules, as the withdrawal decision requires, so that it can be reported (author instruction of 2026-10-26: keep the NCI-60 results).

scope.classification: exploratory, descriptive application; post hoc; not external validation
scope.placement: Supplementary S9.6 only, with registry rows and binomial intervals

inputs.cell_lines: the NCI-60 lines with class I sequence-based typing in Adams et al. 2005 and public reads
inputs.wes: SRA study SRP150855 paired FASTQ (index resources/nci60/wes_fastq_urls.tsv)
inputs.rnaseq: BioProject PRJNA433861 paired FASTQ, subsampled to 50 million pairs with seed 100 as in the earlier run (index resources/nci60/rnaseq_fastq_urls.tsv)
inputs.name_mapping: an explicit, checksummed cell-line name table joining the Adams names to the read accessions; an unmatched line is listed and excluded, never guessed

workflow.caller_failure: a caller that cannot run from FASTQ input (POLYSOLVER is to be checked at a one-line pilot) is a declared non-call for every locus, recorded, never dropped from the panel

method.primary: SimplePluralityLex (ChampHLA-Consensus) with the native-declaration singleton rule, exactly as in the development analysis
method.endpoint: exact unordered two-field genotype concordance over truth-retained loci, fixed denominator (missing predictions count as incorrect), Wilson 95% intervals; callers reported as descriptive comparators

reference_typing.source: Adams S et al. J Transl Med 2005;3:11 (doi:10.1186/1479-5876-3-11), class I table, read from the archived PMC XML (SHA-256 6c1937aac0d1a0f2c2e08cae332745860108a68ed522301c7002e50af93c1f4f) and its tabulation nci60_classI_raw.tsv (SHA-256 8a676ad5df81c114f58b0d25d062d41e8c8af8b31e1af4534667a0eb7b7c58e9), cross-checked against each other

fail_closed_parser.six_digit: XXYYZZ is three-field XX:YY:ZZ, reduced to XX:YY
fail_closed_parser.five_digit: XXYYZ follows the 2005 nomenclature (four digits plus one synonymous digit) and is reduced to XX:YY
fail_closed_parser.two_digit_with_a: an unresolved ambiguity (source footnote: 'two digit denominations with a superscript a'); the locus is excluded from the exact endpoint and listed
fail_closed_parser.new_suffix_or_NR: a new allele or an unresolved typing; the locus is excluded and listed
fail_closed_parser.nomenclature_check: every two-field allele must exist in the pinned IPD-IMGT/HLA 3.65.0 allele list; otherwise the locus is invalid and excluded
fail_closed_parser.single_token_cell: one listed allele is read as a homozygous genotype in the primary analysis, because the source reports the highest-resolution typing per cell line; a sensitivity analysis excludes every single-allele locus
fail_closed_parser.anything_else: any other token shape fails the parse for that locus (excluded and listed); no token is guessed or truncated

reference_typing.truth_firewall: predictions are generated and frozen before the reference typing is joined; the join runs once

authorization.signed: 2026-10-26, explicit author statement in the Claude Code session: 'I signed the nci60 plan'
authorization.signature_rule: sign in the Claude Code session before any NCI-60 input is staged; nothing in this record changes after signature
